name: branch-summary-search
theory_gate_citation: docs/STATUS.md B1 is graded 'Proof target needed': phase plus one tail-boundary bit selects every successor, but computing that bit still depends on a transient growing to 1.335*d. docs/theory/README.md §4 closes no route that bears on whether a compact summary is a state.
notes: Two populations, never pooled. The 'arbitrary' population is a counterexample search against a PROPOSED general recurrence, not a measurement of Rule 30: a recurrence claiming to be general must hold on every history, so a collision there refutes it and nothing else is claimed from it. CLAUDE.md rule 3 governs the 'seed_orbit' population, which uses the single black cell and is reported with its event count so a clean result is not read as a powered one.
